description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development - Notify the Approval of the Amendment  to the City of Colombo Development Plan 1999 and 2008 (Amendment)
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with land and property-related matters, specifically amendments to the City of Colombo Development Plan involving zoning changes (e.g., changing areas from "Special Mixed Residential zone" to "Mixed Development Zone"), building line width adjustments, development fees, and other urban planning regulations.
